Maul's future has been erased, while ''ours'' is more certain than it has ever been.|Count Dooku and Darth Sidious|}} The '''Second Battle of Dathomir'''{{HelmetCollectionCite|39|Databank A-Z}} was a battle fought during the [[Clone Wars]] on [[Dathomir]] between the combined forces of the [[Sith]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; and the renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] and [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]]. The battle began after Maul brought the captive Sith Lord [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to [[Dathomir]], so Talzin could drain the Count's life force and use it to return her previously-destroyed physical form. [[Darth Sidious]] was able to trace the location of Dooku, his apprentice, and traveled with [[General]] [[Grievous]] to Dathomir to rescue Dooku and defeat their enemies. Sidious and Grievous arrived to confront Maul and Talzin, the latter of whom had used her [[magick]] to take control of Dooku's body. This led to a [[lightsaber]] duel, in which Sidious quickly gained the upper hand against the Talzin-controlled Dooku. Talzin appeared in the flesh, returned to her physical form, and held off a [[Force lightning]] assault from Sidious and, eventually, Dooku. Talzin sacrificed her own life to allow Maul to escape, as Grievous fatally stabbed the Dathomir witch through the chest while Maul fled from Dathomir. The Separatists, meanwhile, also attacked Maul's [[Black Sun]] and [[Pyke Syndicate]] allies, leading the [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] to end their alliance with Maul—effectively destroying the [[Shadow Collective]]. Though Maul escaped, Sidious believed his former apprentice's defeat eliminated his future, while securing the future of the Sith. ==Aftermath== Sometime between 19 BBY and [[5 BBY]],''[[The Ghosts of Maul]]'' is set during the [[Imperial Era]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the beginning of to 19 BBY. The story also takes place before Maul was stranded on the [[planet]] [[Malachor]]. "[[Lightsabers and Jedi Equipment]]" states Maul was stranded [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Mission to Malachor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 BBY]]. Therefore, he was stranded during or before [[5 BBY]], and this story must take place sometime between 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 5 BBY. when Maul explored planets in search of advantages,''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' one [[Mission to Damanos|led him]] to a [[Sith castle]] on the planet [[Damanos]]. He was approached by a vision of Grievous, who had been slain by their mutual enemy [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]{{StoryCite|story=The Ghosts of Maul|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith}} during the [[Battle of Utapau]] in 19 BBY.{{HelmetCollectionCite|24|Highlights of the Saga}} During their conversation, "Grievous" taunted Maul, asking if he remembered their last encounter: when he murdered his beloved mother. {{Battle-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]] {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Ghosts of Maul|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith|audiobook=1}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-nightsisters-from-dathomir-a-history|text=The Nightsisters from Dathomir: A History|int=The Nightsisters from Dathomir: A History|nolive=1}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|13|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{BuildFalconCite|44|Starship Fact File}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|38|Databank A-Z}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|39|Databank A-Z}} {{1stID|Second Battle of Dathomir}} *{{BuildFalconCite|68|Starship Fact File}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|48|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|59|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|49|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Star Wars Super Graphic: A Visual Guide to a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|count-dooku|Count Dooku}} *{{Databank|gar-saxon|Gar Saxon}} *{{Databank|mother-talzin|Mother Talzin}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Zweite Schlacht von Dathomir (Klonkriege)#kanon |es=Segunda batalla de Dathomir |ka=დათომირის მეორე ბრძოლა }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dathomir, Second Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Dathomir]] [[Category:Battles of the campaign against the Shadow Collective]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
